sources.note: Developer portal. Lists iKnowMed as point-of-care solution. Describes Certified API Developer Program (self-serve) and Value Add Developer Program (by-invitation with sandbox, marketplace listing). API Portal for FHIR documentation. HQ in Boston.

ONC mandatory disclosures. iKnowMed Generation 2 v3.0 certified 2018-05-08 by Drummond Group. Monthly subscription per user. Relies on NewCropRx and Surescripts Clinical Messaging. Direct exchange limited to DirectTrust/Surescripts network. CMS68v6 quality measure.

Main Ontada site. Oncology technology and insights business, part of McKesson. Name combines 'oncology' and 'data'. Access to ~1.4M patients annually, ~4M patient records via US Oncology Network and Onmark practices. 2,700+ oncology providers use iKnowMed.

iKnowMed product page. Web-based, mobile-optimized with iOS app. 2,700+ providers, 1.5M+ patient portal users, 1M+ clinical decisions supported. Features: clinical decision support, biomarker ordering, patient portal (Ontada Health), practice analytics. ISO 9001:2015 certified. Supports MIPS and Oncology Care Model.

McKesson oncology technology page. Describes iKnowMed as centralized oncology patient record database. Lists Clear Value Plus (clinical decision support with NCCN pathways), Practice Insights (analytics/benchmarking), Ontada Health (patient portal). Biomarker test guidelines by disease type. QCDR for MIPS reporting.
Ontada launch announcement (December 3, 2020). Created by McKesson to combine real-world data, research, iKnowMed EHR, and Clear Value Plus. Connected to US Oncology Network. CEO Brian Tyler quoted.

Company overview. Founded on precise insights for cancer care. Partnerships with Merck, BeiGene, Microsoft (Azure OpenAI), Datavant, Amgen. FDA selected Ontada for rare cancer research. 400+ real-world research publications. 2023 CMS QCDR designation. Timeline spans 2014-2024.

Ontada FHIR Server documentation. REST API using FHIR R4. SMART on FHIR and Client Credentials auth. 30+ FHIR resources including Patient, Encounter, Condition, MedicationRequest, Observation, DiagnosticReport, CarePlan, CareTeam, Immunization, AllergyIntolerance, Procedure, DocumentReference, Coverage, and more. Supports EHI bulk export via Group resource.

EHI export page. Exports compressed zip with pipe-delimited files. Data dictionary (b10_data_dictionary.xlsx) available. Content varies by organization configuration and usage. Compliant with 170.315(b)(10).
KLAS Research rankings (July 2025). iKnowMed scored 80.1 (2nd place behind Epic Beacon at 86.3, ahead of Flatiron OncoEMR at 79.8 and Elekta ONE at 76.7).

KLAS user reviews. Positive: auto-updating NCCN guidelines, strong oncology functionality. Negative: integration/interoperability challenges, interfacing described as 'a nightmare' by some users. Nearly half reported poor interoperability with external EHRs, labs, scheduling.
US Oncology Network announcement of ONC certification. iKnowMed implemented in 620+ sites of care, used by 1,600+ providers.
iKnowMed named top-ranked EHR for oncology/hematology for 5th consecutive year by Black Book Rankings.
McKesson acquired US Oncology Inc. in December 2010 for $2.16 billion (including $1.6B debt assumption). US Oncology owned iKnowMed at that time.
Original US Oncology iKnowMed announcement. iKnowMed developed in 1996, acquired by US Oncology in 2004. Designed to enhance oncology patient experience.
iKnowMed certified by Surescripts for e-prescribing. Enables electronic prescription exchange with pharmacies, real-time eligibility and formulary info.

iKnowMed Generation 2 development announcement (May 2013). Developed in collaboration with 200+ oncologists. Features: cancer diagnosis/staging (AJCC/FIGO), regimen library, flexible documentation, e-prescribing, automated charge capture, auto-sharing clinical notes.

EHR profile. Modules: Appointment Management, Clinical Workflow, Document Management, EM Coding, Medical Templates, Patient Demographics/History, Reporting/Analytics, Voice Recognition, e-Prescription. Cloud-based with iOS/Android apps. HIPAA and ICD-10 certified. Supports 1-50+ physician practices.
Ontada-Microsoft collaboration (2024) using Azure OpenAI to transform unstructured oncology data. Indicates AI/ML investment in data processing.
KLAS analysis of oncology tech landscape. Notes cloud momentum in oncology EHR space and persistent workflow gaps.
